design.name: 👁️ Show Sub Navigation
design.note: In shell-desktop the equivalent property is a variant axis with the values False and True.

design.name: 👁️ Show Drawer
design.note: Mobile only. Navigation level two and deeper can only be shown in the Drawer, desktop has no equivalent.

design.name: 🔄 CP Navigation
design.note: New since the last read. Default resolves to CP → Drill Down - Mobile - Bottom (Beta). Flat Icon is now selected through this swap instead of a dedicated position value.

design.name: 🔀 Control Panel Mobile Position
design.note: Bottom - Flat Icon was removed from this axis. Flat Icon is now reached via the new 🔄 CP Navigation instance swap instead of a position value.
